headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Dahua NVR cameras with motion detection and FFmpeg streaming.
footerDisplay: For help and documentation, visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/pit5bul/homebridge-dahua-ultimate).

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: The name that will appear in your Homebridge log.

host.title: NVR IP Address / Hostname
host.description: The IP address or hostname of your Dahua NVR.

port.title: NVR Port
port.description: The HTTP port of your NVR (typically 80 or 443 for HTTPS).

secure.title: Use HTTPS
secure.description: Enable if your NVR uses HTTPS.

forceDiscovery.title: Force Discovery
forceDiscovery.description: Re-discover cameras on next restart. New cameras will be added; existing cameras keep their settings.

streamType.title: Default Stream Type
streamType.description: Default stream type for all cameras. Substream reduces CPU load significantly.

probeOnStartup.title: Probe Streams on Startup
probeOnStartup.description: Run ffprobe on all cameras at startup to log codec/resolution info. Useful for initial setup. Adds startup delay.

probeTimeout.title: Probe Timeout (ms)
probeTimeout.description: Timeout for ffprobe when probing streams on startup.

videoProcessor.title: Custom FFmpeg Path
videoProcessor.description: Path to a custom FFmpeg binary. Required when using hardware encoders (VAAPI, NVENC, etc.) as the bundled FFmpeg does not include hardware support.

interfaceName.title: Network Interface
interfaceName.description: Network interface to use for streaming. Leave empty to auto-detect.

debugMotion.title: Debug Motion Events
debugMotion.description: Enable verbose logging for motion detection events.

channelId.title: Channel ID
channelId.description: The NVR channel number for this camera.

name.title: Camera Name
name.description: Display name for this camera in HomeKit.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Disable this camera without removing it from config.

streamType.title: Stream Type
streamType.description: Override the global stream type for this camera. Note: if you manually set a custom source URL below, this setting is ignored.

motion.title: Enable Motion Sensor
motion.description: Expose a motion sensor for this camera triggered by NVR events.

motionTimeout.title: Motion Timeout (seconds)
motionTimeout.description: Seconds after motion trigger before the sensor resets. 0 = manual reset only.

source.title: Custom RTSP Source
source.description: Override the auto-generated RTSP source. Leave empty to use the NVR-generated URL. When set, Stream Type above is ignored.

stillImageSource.title: Custom Snapshot Source
stillImageSource.description: Override the auto-generated snapshot URL. Leave empty to use the NVR default.

maxStreams.title: Max Concurrent Streams
maxStreams.description: Maximum simultaneous streams for this camera.

qualityPreset.title: Quality Preset
qualityPreset.description: Strongly recommended. Fixes slow stream starts by forcing a fixed resolution and bitrate from the first HomeKit request, eliminating HomeKit's probe/RECONFIGURE cycle. Choose the preset that matches your NVR stream resolution.

encoder.title: Video Encoder

oneOf.title: VAAPI — Intel/AMD GPU on Linux (recommended for low CPU)

encoder.description: Hardware encoders reduce CPU usage by 70-90%. Requires a custom FFmpeg path (set in Global Advanced) compiled with hardware support.

qualityProfile.title: Encoder Quality Profile

oneOf.title: Balanced — good balance of speed and quality

qualityProfile.description: Tune encode speed vs quality for hardware encoders. Has no effect on software encoding (libx264 always uses ultrafast/zerolatency). Leave empty to use encoder defaults.

hwaccelDevice.title: VAAPI Device Path
hwaccelDevice.description: VAAPI hardware device path. Only relevant when encoder is set to VAAPI. Change only if you have multiple GPUs and the wrong one is selected.

copyAudio.title: Copy Audio (No Transcoding)
copyAudio.description: Pass audio directly without transcoding. Only enable if your camera already outputs AAC or Opus. Most Dahua cameras output G.711/PCM which requires transcoding — enabling this on an incompatible source will result in no audio.

recording.title: Enable HomeKit Secure Video (HKSV)
recording.description: Enable HomeKit Secure Video recording to iCloud on motion. Requires iCloud storage plan and a HomeKit hub.

prebuffer.title: Enable Prebuffering
prebuffer.description: Capture video seconds before motion is detected. Requires recording to be enabled.

prebufferLength.title: Prebuffer Duration (ms)
prebufferLength.description: How many milliseconds of pre-motion video to buffer. Only used when prebuffering is enabled.

encoderOptions.title: Custom Encoder Options
encoderOptions.placeholder: Leave empty — uses Quality Profile automatically
encoderOptions.description: Raw FFmpeg encoder flags. When set, completely overrides the Quality Profile above. Examples: VAAPI '-quality 1 -g 30 -bf 0', NVENC '-preset p4 -tune ll', Software '-preset ultrafast -tune zerolatency'. Check Homebridge logs to verify the generated FFmpeg command.

packetSize.title: RTP Packet Size
packetSize.description: RTP packet size in bytes. Try smaller values (e.g. 188) if video is choppy on WiFi or across VLANs. Must be a multiple of 188.

debug.title: Debug FFmpeg Output
debug.description: Log full FFmpeg output to Homebridge log. Useful for diagnosing stream issues.

unbridge.title: Unbridge Camera
unbridge.description: Run as a separate accessory. May improve performance but requires manual pairing in HomeKit.
